title: Systematic Withdrawal Plan: regular income from your investments
summary: An SWP lets you withdraw a fixed amount from a mutual fund at regular intervals. Learn how it works, how it is taxed and what to watch out for.

title: Step-up SIP: grow your investment with your income
summary: A step-up (top-up) SIP increases your instalment by a fixed percentage every year. See why investors use it and how to set one up.

title: How to read the SEBI risk-o-meter
summary: Every mutual fund scheme shows a risk-o-meter with six levels from Low to Very High. Here is what it tells you and what it does not.

title: Understanding debt mutual funds
summary: Debt funds invest in bonds and money market instruments. Learn about interest-rate risk, credit risk and how different categories differ.

title: ELSS funds: tax saving with a three-year lock-in
summary: Equity Linked Savings Schemes qualify for deduction under Section 80C in the old tax regime. Understand the lock-in, the risks and how they compare with other options.

title: What is a SIP and how does it work?
summary: A Systematic Investment Plan lets you invest a fixed amount in a mutual fund every month. Here is how it works and what to keep in mind.
